summary: Biography of Amazon founder Jeff Bezos from his New Mexico and Texas childhood through Wall Street to founding Amazon in 1994, and how his data-obsessed management built a punishing corporate culture and dangerous warehouse conditions.

evidence.note: born January 1964 in Albuquerque, New Mexico
long segment on the Houston public-school gifted program he attended
fintech career and hedge fund D. E. Shaw before founding Amazon
sales-tax loophole drives the 1994 move to Seattle to found the company
2015 New York Times reporting on Amazon's punishing office culture
Bezos rejects a respect-for-workers paper and pushes warehouse turnover to avoid unions
2011 warehouse heat incident after Bezos refused air conditioning
Kiva robots around 2014 and worker surveillance carry the story to the present

notes: Amazon is treated as co-primary because it is in the title and part 2 is mostly company history. Bezos was alive and still active at release (stepped down as CEO in 2021), so main_span end is null. Episode is framed as a prelude to the Megacorp podcast.
